solution.what: Downloaded the DECODE R7898 image with the saved cookie; dated in clear M cccc xlvj die iiij may (4 May 1446), mixed clear Lombard Italian and graphic cipher.

Mazzatinti's inventory of BnF ital. 1583-1593 (Archivio storico lombardo X, 1883): f. 68 = reply to what Zorzo Maino reported, in cipher; f. 70 = Vincenzo Amidani to Sforza, Milan 4 May, in cipher. No reading printed.
Draft transcription of f. 68: 404 signs, 26 types after merging diacritic variants.

Homophonic annealing with it-cinquecento, clear text as context: unconstrained, capped homophones, nulls allowed, then one-to-one swaps (solver verified on a 400-letter synthetic cipher). All nonsense or degenerate.
Word-pattern search on repeats (FpBHcdSp x2, 8zBprJFp x2, xJpg x4): FpBHcdSp fits 'uisconti' but the other repeats contradict that key.
Found f. 70 (Amidani, same day, same sign family) on DECODE R7899 image P1; transcribed 390 signs; annealing on it alone also gives nonsense.

Downloaded all 208 Sforza key records on DECODE (ASMi Carteggio Sforzesco cart. 1591, 1597, 1598) and scanned them at thumbnail size; read the headings and alphabets of the 15th-c. copies (cart. 1597 nos. 2-36). 1597 no. 14 (18th-c. copy, 'Angelus cum cifra Vincentij', shared with Stavoli, Augustinus, Baptista, Matheus, Vincentius) is the same family: homophones, vowel+consonant syllable signs, word signs (de = cross-circle, ot = divide sign), nulls. Its letter signs do not match the frequent signs of f. 68 or f. 70. 1597 no. 17 (1447, Sforza's envoys to Alfonso) does not match either.
Transcribed by George Lasry with CTTS (CrypTool Transcriber and Solver), who also generated the initial key; the key and reading were improved by Astra and Fable 5.1.
Both images: 839 boxes, 12 clear blocks, 827 cipher occurrences; 780 assigned including 4 provisional, 47 unknown. Shared key, geometry, exports and edited segments verified.

outcome.method_basis: Both partial readings start from George Lasry’s CTTS key; Astra and Fable 5.1 refine transcription and values using the images and companion contexts. Earlier solver runs did not solve the texts.
outcome.notes: Both letters read in part: 780/827 assignments, including 4 provisional; coverage is not accuracy. Signature and boundary groups unresolved.

(8)=L, (24)=N, (16)=IN remain provisional; odd ET, VAIA, RACONMANDO and extra O O are retained.
